[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Stream-of-consciousness writing: Set a timer for 10-15 minutes and write whatever comes to mind.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Free writing with prompts: Use prompts like "I wish..." or "I'm afraid of...".  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Drawing or doodling: Incorporate art into your journaling practice.
